status.until: native recipe→LUT parity and browsing performance are proven on iOS and Android (docs/v1/preset-pack.md, Parity)

catalogue.orderRule: Frozen natural display-name order; no claim of perceptual progression

baseStop.labelRule: Auto only when correction applied; otherwise Original

absolute-white-balance.reason: Absolute Temperature/Tint apply to raw files; Lightroom uses the incremental values on rendered photos (assumption, unverified)

adaptive-tone-global.reason: Lightroom applies Highlights/Shadows/Whites/Blacks adaptively (locally); Lightly applies the calibrated global curve

camera-profile.reason: Camera profile that is not a standard raw base profile; not rendered

creative-profile.reason: Creative profile referenced without its embedded table (a stub), so it cannot be rendered

dehaze-global.reason: Lightroom's Dehaze varies across the image; Lightly applies the calibrated global veil-removal approximation (local dehaze is reserved, not implemented)

enhance-filter.reason: Enhance filter (Denoise / Super Resolution / Raw Details) that changes pixels

enhance-filter-off.reason: Enhance filter entry with Denoise, Super Resolution and Raw Details all off (decoded): no pixel effect

geometry.reason: Crop, perspective and upright are per-photo geometry, not part of a Look

grain-uncalibrated.reason: Grain follows Lightroom's controls with uncalibrated constants and a portable random field (not Lightroom's grain pattern)

iso-adaptive.reason: ISO-adaptive preset: Lightroom interpolates these settings by the photo's ISO; Lightly applies the preset's fixed values (ISO interpolation not implemented)

legacy-pv2010-inactive.reason: Legacy PV2010 key written alongside PV2012+ settings; Lightroom does not use it under process version 2012+

lens-corrections.reason: Lens profile, chromatic aberration and defringe corrections are camera/lens repairs, not part of a Look

local-adjustments.reason: Local adjustments (masks, gradients, brushes) cannot be converted; the rest of the preset renders

local-contrast-calibrated.reason: Clarity/Texture use Lightly's local-contrast operator, calibrated against Lightroom renders but not validated

malformed-tone-curve.reason: Tone curve that cannot be parsed

noise-reduction-provisional.reason: Noise reduction uses a provisional Lightly smoothing operator; not calibrated

point-color.reason: Point Color (targeted colour ranges); not implemented

process-version-2010.reason: Process version before 6.7 (PV2010 or older); its tone sliders are not converted

process-version-2012.reason: Process version 6.7 (PV2012) is rendered with the model calibrated on process versions 10/11 (Version 5/6); the difference is unmeasured

raw-base-profile.reason: Standard raw base profile (Default Color / Adobe Standard / Camera Standard, or the Adobe Color profile Look); raw profiles do not apply to rendered photos (assumption, unverified)

sharpening-provisional.reason: Sharpening uses a provisional Lightly unsharp mask; not calibrated

vignette-uncalibrated.reason: Post-crop vignette follows Lightroom's controls with uncalibrated constants

subset.note: stops are the full catalogue's stops (not contiguous); use for native parity tests only
